subject: NimbusBank vendor review: SCCs, UK addendum, and TIA evidence
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@nimbusbank.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.example 
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor review: routing and TIA requirements

Hi Dylan,

Quick intro — I'm Sara (Vendor Security) at NimbusBank. We're progressing Redwood through our vendor security & legal review for the pilot. Our legal team has two hotspot asks before we can move the DPA/contract forward:

1) International transfers: primary question is whether customer content originating in EU/UK can be processed solely within EEA/UK, or whether any processing or subprocessors route data to the US. We need confirmation of routing controls, and whether Redwood offers an onshore-only processing option for UK customers (or a UK IDTA/UK Addendum path).

2) SCCs/IDTA/TIA evidence: we need the latest Standard Contractual Clauses you rely on, confirmation about the UK IDTA approach (if applicable), and a TIA or DTIA scoping document that shows safeguards for cross-border transfers.

3) Subprocessors: specific question — do you use any telemetry/logging providers or monitoring services that are outside EEA/UK? If so, please identify them and whether you can provide subprocessors' jurisdictions and attestations.

Timeline: our procurement team is aiming to include Redwood in a March pilot; legal wants to lock transfer language by Mar 20. Can you send a short packet (SCC version, UK addendum stance, TIA scoping sheet, and a subprocessor map) this week?

Also: we'll need a technical contact who can share a sample of your access logs retention and a short note on egress/exit procedures for customer data.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Sara Khan
Head of Vendor Security | NimbusBank
sara.khan@nimbusbank.com
+44 20 7946 0XXX

--
From: Sara Khan

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, kimberly_park@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor review: routing and TIA requirements

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Kim (platform security) to get you a concise packet. High-level answers up front while we assemble docs: 

- Routing: Redwood supports EEA-only processing for customer data; we offer a UK Addendum/IDTA path for UK data controllers and a private deployment option for air-gapped/on-prem customers. For hosted customers we can pin region and enforce EEA/UK-only processing for the tenant.

- SCCs/UK addendum: we can execute the EU SCCs and offer a UK Addendum where required. Marissa will confirm the recommended language and provide a draft.

- TIA/DTIA: we maintain a Transfer Impact Assessment template and a scoped TIA for specific regions; we will provide the scoping sheet with suggested safeguards (KMS locations, subprocessors, logging controls).

- Subprocessors: short answer — a small set of monitoring/telemetry vendors operate in the US. We can provide a subprocessor map and per-subprocessor attestation if needed. For sensitive customers we offer options to restrict certain subprocessors or provide dedicated capacity.

Attachments we'll share in follow-up: Redwood_SCCs_v2.pdf (draft), UK_Addendum_Draft.docx, TIA-scoping-sheet.xlsx, subprocessor-map.csv (attestation available).

Marissa/Kim — can you confirm comfort with EEA-only routing language and whether the UK Addendum language in the draft is production-ready? Can Kim also provide a technical point-of-contact for logs/sandbox evidence (retention window, egress procedure)?

Sara — will follow up with the packet by EOD tomorrow.

Best,

Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.example | +1 415-555-01XX

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.example, sara.khan@nimbusbank.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor review: routing and TIA requirements

Thanks, Dylan & Sara — adding legal/controls detail below and attaching the initial packet.

Summary of deliverables (attached):
- Redwood_SCCs_v2.pdf — our standard SCCs + explanatory cover note.
- UK_Addendum_Draft.docx — draft UK addendum language we propose for UK controllers.
- TIA-scoping-sheet.xlsx — fillable scoping sheet; please populate rows in column B where you need specifics from Redwood.

Key legal/controls notes:
1) UK Addendum approach: we can sign an IDTA-style addendum as long as routing and subprocessors are documented for the tenant and the customer chooses EEA/UK processing in the account configuration. The attached draft includes the fallback on subprocessors and a delegation clause for approved subprocessors.

2) SCCs: we rely on the current EU SCCs; if a customer prefers using their redlined SCCs, provide them and we will do a tracked review.

3) Subprocessor attestations: we can provide attestation letters for the specific subprocessors you are concerned about (monitoring, logging, telemetry). For commercial customers we typically provide an attestation (signed) and an excerpted subprocessor map.

4) TIA expectations: for banks we recommend the following TIA scoping fields be completed: personal data categories, data flows (ingress/egress), retention windows, KMS zones, and any cross-border replication. Once completed we will produce a consolidated TIA document and recommended mitigations (encryption at rest in-region, KMS key residency, strict routing controls).

Action items (owners/dates):
- Dylan: deliver attachments and subprocessor map (completed) — due EOD 2028-03-02.
- Kim: provide technical evidence (log retention policy, sample logs, egress/exit runbook) and nominate a platform contact — due 2028-03-03.
- Sara/Nimbus: complete the TIA scoping sheet with any additional risk flags — due 2028-03-07.

We can accommodate a more restrictive configuration for Nimbus if you need to exclude certain US-based subprocessors; that often maps to Reserved/Dedicated deployment or a Private deployment. I'll highlight any legal tradeoffs if you choose that path.

Attaching: Redwood_SCCs_v2.pdf; UK_Addendum_Draft.docx; TIA-scoping-sheet.xlsx

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example

From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@nimbusbank.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor review: routing and TIA requirements

Marissa / Dylan — thanks for the packet and clear action plan. A few clarifications before we hand this to legal/procurement for sign-off: 

- EEA-only routing: can you confirm whether session metadata (e.g., usage telemetry, crash telemetry) is ever asynchronously forwarded to services hosted in the US for analytics? If so, we need to mark that in the TIA and may request additional contractual commitments.

- Subprocessor attestation: we'd like the attestation for the logging/monitoring vendor and for the metrics pipeline. If possible can you include a statement of the jurisdiction where logs are stored and the retention period for customer logs in your attestation?

- Sandbox evidence: procurement is asking if you can provide a short, timeboxed sandbox review (1 day) where our infra team can verify that tenant data remains in-region and verify the egress configuration. Who is the best technical contact to run this?

Tentative timeline from our side: we will complete the scoping sheet by 2028-03-07 and expect procurement to be ready to proceed after we receive your attestation and sandbox evidence (target Mar 20).

If you can send the attestation and nominate Kim (or another platform lead) as the sandbox contact, that will keep us on track.

Thanks — Sara

Sara Khan
Head of Vendor Security | NimbusBank
